content.body:
The Chat window is your primary method of communicating with other players. Understanding it is important to your success in World War II Online. You can also enter various commands with it.
It has 6 numbered radios that are tuned to various channels, such as Mission, Squad, and Side. Each radio can be accessed by pressing the function key matching the radio number: F1 for radio 1.
When you are in the game world, your default chat channel (when you press Enter to chat, rather than one of the radios), is Area chat. Friendly players within 100 meters will receive your message.
content.title: The Chat Window
